metadata.title: Elite Utility Seed: Specialized Professional Standards
metadata.notes: Highly specialized industry standards for advanced technical roles.

nodes.title: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
nodes.description: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) fundamentals. Managing multi-cloud resources with Terraform. Mapping declarative infrastructure to Mycelix node configuration.

nodes.title: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
nodes.description: Cluster architecture, installation, and configuration; Workloads and scheduling; Services and networking; Storage; Troubleshooting.

nodes.title: FANUC Robot Operator Certification
nodes.description: Safe operation and programming of FANUC industrial robots. Jogging, coordinate systems, and basic task execution. Linked to the Manipulator platform track.

nodes.title: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty
nodes.description: Designing, implementing, and deploying machine learning solutions. Data engineering, exploratory data analysis, and model evaluation.

nodes.title: Salesforce Certified Administrator
nodes.description: Advanced configuration and management of the Salesforce platform. User management, security, and data analysis. Bridging SME finance to enterprise CRM admin.

nodes.title: Certified Energy Manager (CEM)
nodes.description: Optimization of energy performance in facilities and systems. Energy auditing, lighting, HVAC, and renewable energy. Linked to the Helios and Clime tracks.

edges.rationale: P2P network topology training provides the networking foundation required for Kubernetes administration.
Bipedal and rugged locomotion training covers the foundational coordinate system and joint mechanics needed for FANUC robotics.
Active inference and neural homeostasis provide the theoretical grounding for advanced machine learning evaluation.
Solar mini-grid capstones satisfy the majority of field-work requirements for energy management certification.
